description.value: Katsuya is Canada's first specialized tonkatsu (pork cutlet) restaurant, established in 2015 and ranked among Canada's top 100 restaurants for five consecutive years as a single brand. The Coquitlam location prepares its signature katsu daily using fresh, locally sourced ingredients along with house-made breadcrumbs and sauce. Cyclists will find a sit-down Japanese restaurant offering both dine-in and takeout, part of a growing Canadian chain with locations across BC, Ontario, Alberta, and Quebec.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 89m; building (covered, paid) at 96m. Total: 10 spaces.
